COMPLETED: Hardened eslint.config.mjs to permit tabIndex={0} on 'tabpanel' and 'region' roles for WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard scrolling.
COMPLETED: Audited legacy tailwind.config.ts against globals.css; confirmed 1:1 token parity under Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first configuration, deprecating standalone configuration files.
COMPLETED: Deprecated redundant wrappers (ActionButton.tsx, NavigationLink.tsx, Page.tsx) unifying under core primitives.

COMPLETED: Visual telemetry audit & refactor of LocalJobsGrid.tsx (container gutter constraints, external navigation link typing, React.forwardRef integration).
COMPLETED: Visual telemetry audit & refactor of TabbedInterface.tsx (centered pill capsule, outer bounding container border, WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard-scrollable region, empty-state inspection graphic).

COMPLETED: Visual telemetry audit & refactor of HeroSection.tsx (eradicated JIT bracket values, fixed invalid Link-wrapping-Button nesting bug, ambient decorative blur accents).

COMPLETED: Component Directory Taxonomy Governance enforced. Files physically relocated across /components/ui, /components/blocks, /components/layout, and /components/storyblok. Barrel export (index.ts) established for blocks.

COMPLETED: Hardened src/lib/dto/sanitizeStoryPayload.ts. Implemented Zod schema validation for core metadata, tag_list, and is_startpage, unwrapped nested API client response structures, and exported safeSanitizeStoryPayload discriminated union to prevent unhandled 500 crashes.

COMPLETED: Wired safeSanitizeStoryPayload into src/app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx. Deduplicated metadata and rendering passes via React.cache, ensured clean 404 boundary handling on corrupt or missing payloads, and upgraded root container to a semantic main landmark with skip-link focus support.

COMPLETED: Hardened src/components/storyblok/StoryblokProvider.tsx. Switched import boundary to @storyblok/react for client hook compatibility, registered PromoBanner, consolidated presentational imports via barrel exports, and disabled fallback component dumps in production.
COMPLETED: Executed local runtime smoke test via npm run verify and npm run dev. TypeScript watch compiled with 0 errors, Next.js mounted clean in 5.0s, and GET / returned HTTP 200 OK.

COMPLETED: Applied runtime fixes: (1) Injected early 404 fast-fail for system/browser paths (.well-known, favicon.ico) in src/app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx; (2) Corrected aspect-ratio auto-scaling on logosm.svg in MainHeader.tsx. Staged, committed, and pushed to remote origin.

COMPLETED: Mobile-First Responsive Breakpoint & Fluid Typography Refactor. Standardized globals.css with WCAG 2.2 AA compliant clamp() font sizing, fluid gutter/section spacing tokens, and intrinsic auto-fit CSS grid layouts across layout.tsx, HeroSection.tsx, TabbedInterface.tsx, BlogGrid.tsx, and LocalJobsGrid.tsx. Completely eliminated discrete media-query snapping.

ACTIVE / NEXT STEP: Storyblok API Key & Environment Variable Sanitization. Audit repository to guarantee no hardcoded tokens exist. Establish .env.local and .env.example templates. Configure GitHub Repository Secrets / CI/CD injection variables to keep API keys strictly out of version control.
